prose: a device whose loaded code predates the wire codec answers wrong instead of refusing. Measured 2026-11-14 on akienasus: codemother (last_known 2026-11-13T02:25Z, started before 5f4021427 'the inspect wire shape is a tool codemother publishes') answers inspect reason_has_referent(reason, repo=Path(...)) with data False, while the same judge in-process answers True and the bus ask without kwargs answers True; the {"__wire__": "path"} kwarg arrives undecoded. Every /sorted cast with a 'none, because <path>' field is refused on that box until codemother restarts. The current wire_decode raises on an unknown kind, but a process older than the decoder cannot; nothing tells a client the answering process runs older code than the checkout that asked.
